On the last morning of the summer, my grandmother set a tray of my croissants in the front window, next to hers, and did not say which was which. A regular customer bought two of mine. Some prefer old brick, whose mortar leaches lime; others colonize the concrete of highway overpasses, where the surface stays like that from runoff. Okafor's atlas has since been used by the city's planners, whom consult it when choosing materials for new public spaces. [D]

Colleagues asked when she would return to "real" fieldwork, and one reviewer of her first paper wondered whether mosses on parking garages constituted an ecosystem worth studying. The tone they recorded matched the field recordings closely and was very similar to them, confirming that the sound comes from the sand itself, not from the shape of the dune. [5] The dunes that sing are rare, and several of the best-known ones lie near growing cities.
